**Summary**

This PR adds a new CSS class modifier and a key in `cssClasses` for the `hierarchicalMenu()` widget, following the addition made in the CSS specs.

| InstantSearch.css class name | Key in `cssClasses` |
| --- | --- |
| `.ais-HierarchicalMenu-link--selected` | `selectedItemLink` |

> **Note**
> In its current state, the widget does not conform to the InstantSearch.css specs. Since fixing this now introduces breaking changes to the DOM, I added a mention in the relevant component to address this when working on next major version.

[FX-1793](https://algolia.atlassian.net/browse/FX-1793)
